notes.title: Optimization Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I've been working on an update that massively improves performance of the game.  In some test builds I increased my frame rate by 20 fps when walking around the starting village. 

I hope you enjoy the improved performance!

-Gogodinosaur

notes.title: Merchant Isle Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Merchant Isle has been updated to V1.0.6.  This update includes some improvement to menu visuals, object loading, and collision blockers.  See the full change list below:

We are excited to continue to improve the game over time!

Changes
[list]
[*] Alter main menu background
[*] Improve main menu visuals
[*] Improve settings menu visuals
[*] Improve trade item icons
[*] Improve water blocking volumes in towns
[*] Provide the ability to skip the intro sequence
[*] Update the path visuals in some towns
[*] Optimize object streaming for smoother performance
[/list]

-Gogodinosaur

notes.title: New tip menu and bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Created a new tip menu that is accessible in the escape menu
[*] Fixed collision boxes in a few locations
[*] Fix a bug where players could climb on a storm cloud
[*] Fix a bug where a town's demand showed E_Max
[*] Fix a bug where players could negotiate with a merchant many times per day
[/list]

notes.title: Player loading height bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where players would start at a height that would land them in the ground when loading the game.

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix dialogue UI not closing at second bridge ticket check location
[*] Fix bug causing a load game from starting the player in the ground
[*] Fix a few collision boxes
[*] Show credits and version number in the main menu
[*] Update UI based image texture group to help increase UI image quality on lower settings
[/list]

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed the graphics for some of the ticket art.
[*] Fixed a collision volume bug
[/list]

notes.title: Save system hot fix
notes.content: Fixed the save file name, so that save games can be properly loaded.
